narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: the single idea of the chapter in one image - one ancestral six-limbed body radiating into many Pandoran shapes, with one quiet four-limbed exception.
subject: A central luminous six-limbed creature silhouette, elegant and anatomically clear, from which faint ghostly variants radiate outward in a gentle fan - a winged form, a swimming finned form, a running form - all sharing the same glowing skeletal frame; off to one side, smaller and set slightly apart, a single upright four-limbed humanoid silhouette stands quietly, its missing middle limbs implied by a faint dimmed gap.
scene: A dark naturalist's specimen space, the forms floating as if pinned in glowing display, deep haze beyond.
camera: A clean front-on display view, the central creature largest, the radiating variants smaller and softer toward the edges.
light: Bioluminescent key glowing from within the skeletal frames, cyan and teal; the lone humanoid lit a touch warmer and dimmer to set it apart; deep indigo shadow throughout.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan and living-teal glow in the frames, one scarce amber accent on the humanoid exception, restrained.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted texture, confident focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the central creature's six-limbed frame; the radiating variants softer; the lone humanoid clear but quieter; edges dissolving into haze.
composition: Radial fan from a strong central figure, generous dark negative space, the four-limbed exception placed on a lower third line apart from the fan.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key from within the specimens. Same dark glowing-specimen mood as the established chapter covers.
